title: Align sessions and copy ROIs
description: Aligns each selected entity's FOV image to the first one's by phase correlation (whole pixels), and saves the first entity's ROIs, moved by that shift, as each other entity's ROIs. With a largest rotation, each image is also turned back by every angle up to it, in steps, and the angle that correlates best is taken; the ROIs are turned by it about the image centre. Rejected ROIs are left out, and pixels moved outside the image are dropped. Stacks are averaged over frames.

image.title: FOV image
image.description: Variable that holds each entity's FOV image (or a stack, which is averaged).

rois.title: ROIs
rois.description: Variable that holds the first entity's ROIs.

output.title: Copied ROIs
output.description: Variable the moved ROIs are saved to, for every entity but the first.
